name: That Fateful Night
source:
When she walked away, a part of me left with her.

Even when two years have passed, Patrice still can't get Nia out of his head. He's about to start college soon, wanting to move on and meet new people.

But her presence lingers; her memory follows him everywhere he goes. He doesn't know if he can love anyone else the same way he loved her. 

The grief she left behind doesn't go away...

That Fateful Night is a romance visual novel with NSFW elements that focuses on Patrice and his backstory before the events of Moonlight Castle.

[From [url=https://keykoz.itch.io/that-fateful-night]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当她走开时，我的一部分也跟着她离开了。

即使两年过去了，帕特里斯仍然无法将尼亚从脑海中抹去。他即将开始上大学，想要继续前进并结识新朋友。

但她的存在依然存在；无论他走到哪里，她的记忆都跟着他。他不知道自己是否可以像爱她一样爱别人。

她留下的悲伤并没有消失……

《那个命运之夜》是一部带有NSFW元素的浪漫视觉小说，主要讲述帕特里斯及其在月光城堡事件之前的背景故事。

[来自[url=https://keykoz.itch.io/that-fateful-night]Itch.io[/url]]
